iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

DIAMETER::drop
       Drops the current message quietly.

SYNOPSIS
       DIAMETER::drop

DESCRIPTION
       This iRule command drops the current Diameter message quietly.

       Syntax DIAMETER::drop

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       DIAMETER_INGRESS, DIAMETER_EGRESS, DIAMETER_RETRANSMISSION, MR_INGRESS, MR_EGRESS, MR_FAILED

EXAMPLES
	when DIAMETER_INGRESS {
	    if { [DIAMETER::command 275] && [DIAMETER::is_request] } {
		DIAMETER::drop
	    }
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.0.0 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
